metadata.title: Assisted Housing Condition Panel (AHCP) v1.0: harmonized HUD public housing and multifamily physical inspection scores, 2000-2026
metadata.description:
AHCP is a property-level panel of U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) physical inspection scores for public housing and HUD-assisted or insured multifamily housing. It stacks the 9 score-file vintages HUD still publishes (2011 to 2026), reconciles them, and reconstructs 313,732 unique inspections for 65,337 properties dated 2000-01-11 to 2026-04-03, with the UPCS or NSPIRE protocol flagged and each property linked to its 2020 census tract, HUD subsidy record, LIHTC record and CDC PLACES tract health estimates.

Coverage is incomplete: no published file covers 2010-2012, and files from 2016 on list only each property's latest inspection. See docs/LIMITATIONS.md before use. The deposit includes a codebook, a provenance log with SHA-256 hashes of every input, the Python pipeline, and an R package.
